items.title: Widerspruch (objection) against the Beitragsbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 21.05.2026, sent by ordinary post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X the notice is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 3rd day after posting: 21.05. + 3 days = 24.05.2026, a Sunday. Because that fictional delivery day falls on a Sunday, established practice (applying the § 193 BGB / § 108 Abs. 3 AO principle analogously via § 26 SGB X) shifts the deemed delivery to the next business day, Monday 25.05.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG) then starts running the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 26.05.2026, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the Bekanntgabe day (25th) → 25.06.2026. That day is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.

items.title: First monthly contribution (health + long-term care insurance) via direct debit
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Membership starts 01.06.2026, so the first contribution month is June 2026. The letter states contributions are collected on the 15th of the following month ('Folgemonat'), i.e. for June's contribution the collection date is 15.07.2026. 15.07.2026 is a Tuesday/Wednesday (not a weekend or NRW holiday), so no adjustment is required. This collection recurs monthly thereafter on the 15th of each following month for as long as the membership continues.
